resources.string: Turn on Android Auto developer mode
Without this, Android Auto will not show apps installed outside Google Play.

You only need to turn it on once: the head unit server keeps running in the background, Headswap does not turn it off. If Android closes it on its own, turn it on again from the Android Auto settings. There is no auto-start through accessibility any more, so the head unit server has to be started by hand.

string-array.name: step_notif_list
string-array.item: Tap “Allow” at the bottom of the screen
Tap “Allow” in the Android window “Allow Headswap to send you notifications?”

resources.string: The notification shade shows how the connection is going, and Android will not unload Headswap while the screen is off.
The Headswap activation code is entered right in the notification. The notification shade also shows how the connection to the head unit is going.

string-array.name: step_background_list
string-array.item: Scroll to Headswap and turn the switch on

string-array.name: step_mic_list
string-array.item: Tap “Allow” at the bottom of the screen

resources.string: Needed to call the voice assistant.
Needed for calls: in Android Auto they go only through Bluetooth.
Without it Google Maps and other map apps in Android Auto say “location access required”.

string-array.name: step_first_list
string-array.item: Unlock the phone and plug the cable into the head unit
Check “Use by default for this USB accessory”

resources.string: If the head unit shows a “启动CarLife” screen, tap that button.
Everything is ready for the trip
Tap an item to open its step.
We will fill in the settings the community verified on this car. Experienced users can skip this step.
What to show on the head unit. You can change it in Settings at any time.
Standard AA: maps, music and calls from Android Auto. Works through its head-unit server.
The head unit shows the Headswap desktop or a car launcher from the phone.
This mode needs Android developer mode and Headswap activation through “Wireless debugging”.
These are risky settings. You turn them on at your own risk.

string-array.name: step_devmode_list
string-array.item: Tap “Build number” 7 times until “You are now a developer” appears
If the phone asks, enter its PIN

resources.string: Developer mode is needed only for “Wireless debugging”. If it is already on, tap “Already done”.

string-array.name: step_activate_list
string-array.item: Tap “Activate”, “Developer options” opens (on Xiaomi: Additional settings → Developer options)
Turn on “Wireless debugging” and tap “Pair device with pairing code”
Type the code shown into the Headswap notification

resources.string: Activation is lost after the phone reboots. Headswap will ask you to repeat it, it takes half a minute.
